findings.text: store_request re-encodes the cells-to-request mapping that already sits inline in scripts/prototypes/fast_map_production/solver.py:85 as `-500 if cells == 550 else -cells`, without extending or importing a shared owner; a change to the request-cell relation would have to be made in two places, and only the new one routes through the published FIXTURE_REQUESTS sentinel.

the round-trip assertions at lines 68-70 (axis against record.axis_r/record.axis_z) and line 72 (boundary against record.fed_back_psi) compare the re-read value to the value the producer stored from that very reading (export_records.py:231,242-248), so both sides move together and a consistently wrong read passes them; they hold only as a codec transport check and are backed by the independent analytic assertions at lines 77 and 81-88, which is what carries the durability.

runtime producer code imports the private helper `_analytic_inputs` from the test module tests/equilibrium/test_topology_read.py (also imported by panels.py:35), so both the producer and the panel renderer depend on a test file that lies outside this node's write paths; the analytic certificate input source belongs to a support owner rather than a test module.

the manifest's after_suite arm carries revision 74056d2a56f13fb735a3cf9166e0ea11eb80cc8d, which is not the promoted head 6b45110446225ad095b27511764609c6b8cab9df; panels.py changed in 8593f38d5 after that gate (the wall-contact marker and the legend), and panels.py has no assertion covering it, so the final panel revision rests on the manual figure render (logs/figure-review-contact.log) alone and the pytest receipt does not cover it.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 34d4c304b (ea26beeeb producer+test+panels, fb8e8773b panels, c1e87c413 docs, 37d5b1a91 gate.sh, 4ffbc6adf/7408fb784/055d84935 evidence/docs, 0d4fe1cb5 analytic-comparison repair, 2b7f3d417/f299f89cc/fda5177a0 panels/docs, 74056d2a5 gate.sh logging, 8593f38d5 panels contact marker, 6b4511044 evidence); eight files, 7771 insertions, all inside the declared scope, with no runtime caller outside the package.
item_verdicts.done_when: the brief's three clauses are (1) both carriers as version-2 records read from the fixture store, (2) a README stating the boundary decision, (3) a committed round-trip test with one panel per record; all three are present (export_records.py, exports/README.md, test_export_records.py, docs/figures/converged-forward-solve/certified-carrier-export), and test_export_records.py:51 measures clause 3 against the analytic certificate within the stated tolerances, though clause 1's explicit COCOS-17 statement lives in the README rather than in the record, whose polarity field (+1) is what the codec maps to COCOS-17 at orientation.py:15.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to export nova's one limited and one diverted certified analytic carrier as imas-efit version-2 boundary trace records; export_records.py:174 build_export and :261 write_export write both records and exports/README.md states the decision for each, so the goal is met.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, twelve commits, a baseline arm of 2 collection errors at exit 2 (the module did not exist at the base) and an after arm of 4 passed at exit 0, and negative_control_log names logs/gate-negative-control-74056d2a5.log, a complete red log with EXIT=1 and the two test_round_trip ids.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the source node was fenced to scripts/prototypes/certified_carrier_export, docs/research/certified-carrier-export.html, docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/certified-carrier-export.html and docs/figures/converged-forward-solve/certified-carrier-export plus run-dir logs and exports; all eight files in git diff 34d4c304b..6b4511044 are inside those paths.

justifications.durability: test_export_records.py:77 asserts the re-read axis against the independent analytic certificate, :79-88 asserts the diverted boundary and its sole admitted saddle against the analytic X-point, and :95-118 asserts a negated grid is refused with TopologyReason.NO_QUALIFIED_AXIS, all of which redden on a read or polarity regression, while :68-72 still compare the re-read against the values the producer stored from that same reading.
justifications.evidence: the after arm (4 passed, exit 0, logs/gate-after-74056d2a5.log carrying revision, tree, command and EXIT lines) records the round trip and the negative control names a complete red log with EXIT=1 and the two test_round_trip ids, but that after arm ran at 6b4511044's predecessor 74056d2a5 rather than the promoted head 6b4511044.
justifications.fit: export_records.py and panels.py use capability-named symbols with no plan label and follow the sibling prototype idiom, but export_records.py:47 imports the private `_analytic_inputs` from the test module tests/equilibrium/test_topology_read.py into runtime code.
justifications.goal_fidelity: export_records.py:174 build_export builds and :261 write_export writes both carriers with the 65x65 analytic psi over the wall bbox (grid_axes, :94), the read axis, the polarity and the per-loop wall, and exports/README.md states the limited/diverted decision, the level, the contact/saddle and the certificate bound for each.
justifications.reuse: the module imports the owners it extends rather than copying them (trace_record.py:43 _closed_ring, crosscheck.py:38 lattice and wall_units, orientation.py:39 read_convention, TraceSplineField, cached_carrier), but store_request:147 re-encodes a cells-to-request mapping already inline in fast_map_production/solver.py:85.
justifications.scope_discipline: every one of the eight files in git diff 34d4c304b..6b4511044 (producer, gate.sh, test, panels, two docs, two SVGs) is inside the declared written paths and no out-of-scope path is touched.
